tools.name: get_client_summary
tools.description: Summary of a client: totals invoiced, outstanding balance, total paid, and counts.

tools.name: list_client_tax_identifiers
tools.description: List the tax identifiers (e.g. VAT, GSTIN, TIN) configured for a client.

tools.name: add_contact
tools.description: Add a new contact (email + optional name) to an existing client.

tools.name: add_client_tax_identifier
tools.description: Add a tax identifier (VAT, GSTIN, TIN, ABN, CNPJ, TRN, Other) to a client.

tools.name: remove_client_tax_identifier
tools.description: Remove a tax identifier from a client by identifier ULID.

tools.name: get_dashboard_stats
tools.description: Aggregate dashboard stats: outstanding and overdue totals per currency, invoice counts by status, client count.

tools.name: get_total_outstanding
tools.description: Total outstanding invoiced amounts per currency, optionally filtered by client.

tools.name: get_total_overdue
tools.description: Total overdue invoiced amounts per currency, optionally filtered by client.

tools.name: get_invoice_status_distribution
tools.description: Count of invoices grouped by status.

tools.name: get_revenue_by_period
tools.description: Revenue from captured payments between two dates, grouped by day, week, or month.

tools.name: list_overdue_invoices
tools.description: List overdue invoices, optionally for a specific client.

tools.name: list_invoices_by_status
tools.description: List invoices filtered by status.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a new invoice for a client, with line items, optional discount, due date, contacts, and invoice-level taxes.

tools.name: apply_invoice_transition
tools.description: Apply a workflow transition (accept, cancel, overdue, pay, reopen, archive) to an invoice.

tools.name: apply_recurring_transition
tools.description: Apply a workflow transition to a recurring invoice.

tools.name: clone_invoice
tools.description: Clone an existing invoice into a new draft with the same line items.

tools.name: send_invoice_reminder
tools.description: Email a manual reminder for an invoice to its contacts.

tools.name: list_recurring_invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoices, optionally filtered by status and/or client.

tools.name: create_recurring_invoice
tools.description: Create a new recurring invoice for a client with a scheduled cadence (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).

tools.name: list_resource
tools.description: List records of a SolidInvoice resource with optional filters and pagination.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Fetch a single SolidInvoice record by ID.

tools.name: create_resource
tools.description: Create a new record of a safe, flat resource (client, contact, tax).

tools.name: update_resource
tools.description: Update scalar fields on an existing record (client, contact, tax).

tools.name: delete_resource
tools.description: Delete a record (client, contact, tax) belonging to the active company.

tools.name: list_workflow_transitions
tools.description: List transitions currently enabled on a record (invoice, quote, or recurring_invoice).

tools.name: list_payment_methods
tools.description: List configured payment methods for the current company.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Record an offline payment against an invoice; the invoice transitions to paid once its balance is settled, and any overpayment becomes client credit.

tools.name: list_quotes_by_status
tools.description: List quotes filtered by status.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Create a new quote for a client, with line items, optional discount, due date, contacts, and invoice-level taxes.

tools.name: apply_quote_transition
tools.description: Apply a workflow transition (send, accept, decline, cancel, reopen, archive) to a quote.

tools.name: clone_quote
tools.description: Clone an existing quote into a new draft with the same line items.

tools.name: convert_quote_to_invoice
tools.description: Convert a quote into a new invoice, copying client, line items, and totals.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Return id, name, and default currency for the active company.

tools.name: list_tax_rates
tools.description: List tax rates configured for the current company.

tools.name: create_tax_rate
tools.description: Create a new tax rate (name, rate, type, category, compound flag).

tools.name: update_tax_rate
tools.description: Update an existing tax rate. Pass only the fields you want to change.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List products in the catalogue, optionally filtered by a search term (name or description).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get a single product by id.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a catalogue product (name, price, description, default quantity, tax rate). Price and quantity are decimal strings.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Update a product. Pass only the fields you want to change.

tools.name: delete_product
tools.description: Delete a product from the catalogue.
